violations.description: POISONS/TOXIC MATERIALS AND MEDICINE (3 pts): Chemical spray bottle in the kitchen noted without a identification label. Corrected by labeling bottle and training on the topic.

FLOORS WALLS CEILINGS (1 pts): Walls in the ware-washing area noted with holes in need of caulking. Also the caulk between the wall and the 3-compartment sink was noted in need of repair and replacement. | FLOORS WALLS CEILINGS (1 pts): Floors in the walk-in cooler noted in need of cleaning.
TOILET FACILITIES (1 pts): Toilet room door noted not self closing. Self closing hinges or a closing mechanism needs to be installed on all restroom doors.

COLD AND HOT STORAGE EQUIPMENT (4 pts): Cold holding unit in the facility being used for cold holding temp of 41 degrees F was not functioning adequately. Cooler had lost power. TCS food items of concern were disposed of from cooler and power was restored to the cooler to correct the violation.

HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): A hand drying device (paper towels) was noted not provided at the hand washing lavatory in both employee restrooms. Paper towels were replaced to correct the violation.

SANITIZATION OF EQUIP. AND UTENSILS (4 pts): Inadequate sanitizing with quaternary ammonia was noted in the three compartment sink. To correct the violation the manager unscrewed the bag of sanitizer liquid from the dispenser releasing the vacuum on the dispenser and correcting the issue. Critical violation corrected on the spot.
FLOORS WALLS CEILINGS (1 pts): Floors in the back storage area noted needs repair (cracking).
TOILET FACILITIES (1 pts): Toilet room door noted not self closing.
